maddeler.e:
ننسحق (form VII)
# نَنْسَحِقُ (nansaḥiqu) /nan.sa.ħi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# نَنْسَحِقَ (nansaḥiqa) /nan.sa.ħi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# نَنْسَحِقْ (nansaḥiq) /nan.sa.ħiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
